original_finding.first_contract: The public window leaf function accepts checked CuboidDimensions and turns width or height divided by 0.19 into usize board/came counts, then iterates those counts without a budget. CuboidDimensions accepts any finite nonnegative component, and its SignedLength leaf is finite-only. A finite component near f32::MAX is admissible; division can become infinity and a Rust float-to-integer cast saturates to usize::MAX, leaving a correspondingly enormous loop. The loop does not inspect the builder’s latched error; into_meshes returns that error only after the producer completes the loops. Work, allocation failure or termination could occur first. This is mathematical source analysis, not a runtime observation.
